candidate_identity.note: The implementation base is immutable history. Every qualification run records its own candidate commit, tree, delta and fingerprint.

cross_lane_exclusion_proofs.reason: The checked Release golden is intentionally unavailable in the RelWithDebInfo sanitizer profile; Release proves the exact golden while sanitizer executes every other registered case with zero skips.

rotating_identities.rule: Recompute all identities from exact final inputs. The mf2 composition-contract change must rotate compiler-contract-dependent identities together; environment-only identity rotates only if its exact inputs changed.

qualification_lanes.claim: Exact clean candidate, image-contained ABI, dependency and regression-input preflight
container_command:
set -euo pipefail; python3 scripts/qualification/source_identity.py --repo-root /workspace > /qualification-output/candidate-source.json; test "$(git --no-optional-locks -C .docker/roboplan rev-parse HEAD)" = e06d1a2f1b749c38742aee9e401bbe97fa967f7b; test -z "$(git --no-optional-locks -C .docker/roboplan status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all --ignore-submodules=none)"; (cd third_party/roboplan && sha256sum -c patches.sha256); test "$(sha256sum /usr/local/bin/check_urdf | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 83352c180a270474e19ac0d960871ee5104263bd03ec1402d4905a4024d2a109; python3 - <<'PY'
import json, sys, sysconfig
import coal, pinocchio, pybind11
print(json.dumps({'python': sys.version.split()[0], 'soabi': sysconfig.get_config_var('SOABI'), 'py_debug': bool(sysconfig.get_config_var('Py_DEBUG')), 'gil_disabled': bool(sysconfig.get_config_var('Py_GIL_DISABLED')), 'pybind11': pybind11.__version__, 'pinocchio': pinocchio.__version__, 'coal': coal.__version__}, sort_keys=True))
PY
